testCase:
G-011: List that re-renders between look and act
Goal: Archive the Quintavelle report and the Mirelle report.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/index.html#s11
STEP 2: Click "Archive Quintavelle report"
STEP 3: Verify that 'Archived: Quintavelle report' is visible
STEP 4: Click "Refresh"
STEP 5: Verify that 'Manual refresh 1' is visible
STEP 6: Click "Archive Mirelle report"
STEP 7: Verify that 'Archived: Mirelle report' is visible

plan.title: G-011: Archive reports across list re-render

steps.note: Open the re-rendering list test page.
Archive the Quintavelle report by its named control.
Confirm the correct report was archived.
Locate and archive the Mirelle report after the refresh.
Confirm the correct report was archived after re-rendering.

reasoning: This test checks that the Quintavelle and Mirelle reports can be archived across a manual list refresh. The plan targets each archive control by its visible name and asserts both archive confirmations and the refresh confirmation.
